description: Custom node for total control over resolution and aspect ratio. It provides an intuitive interface with an interactive canvas, advanced scaling options, extensive presets (SDXL, Flux, WAN), and a manager for custom presets, as well as model-specific optimizations for high-quality AI image generation.
